question.text: Scenario: Capital Edge Research Pvt Ltd is a newly registered research entity planning to set up operations. The founder, Nikhil Shah, is designing the firm's compliance framework. He needs to address: (1) How to structure analyst compensation without creating IB conflicts. (2) What disclosures to include in every research report. (3) How to handle situations where the firm also provides IB advisory services. (4) What trading restrictions to impose on analysts and their associates. (5) How to maintain a website as per SEBI requirements. The firm plans to cover 50 companies across 5 sectors, employ 8 full-time analysts and 3 part-time analysts, and offer both subscription-based research and fee-based advisory services to accredited investors. Question 2 of 5: Which set of disclosures must Capital Edge include in its research reports?

answer.text: Financial interest, 1%+ ownership, material conflicts, compensation/public-offering/IB or merchant banking or brokerage relationships, officer/director role, market making, and other Board-specified disclosures

explanation.text: The Logic: Research-report disclosures include financial interest, 1%+ ownership, material conflicts of interest, compensation/public-offering/IB or merchant banking or brokerage relationships, officer/director role, market making, and any other disclosures specified by the Board. The Trap: Disclosure of AI tool usage to the client is a separate client disclosure obligation; it is not framed in the workbook as a mandatory item required in every research report itself. Note: Research-report disclosures (regulation on disclosures) are distinct from client-level AI-use disclosure obligations.
